"""Source-bound constructed-only author execution; no production input options."""
from hashlib import sha256
import json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p/'src/lupine_discovery/decision_pool.py').is_file())
sys.path.insert(0,str(HERE/'scripts'))
import mpea_archive_driver as driver
import mpea_archive_report

def main():
    names=[*list((HERE/'scripts').glob('mpea_archive_*.py')),
           HERE/'scripts/mpea_stage_usage.py',HERE/'scripts/mpea_study_flow.py',
           *list((HERE/'tests').glob('test_mpea_archive*.py')),
           *list((HERE/'tests').glob('mpea_archive*.py')),
           HERE/'tests/mpea_constructed_fixture.py',HERE/'tests/test_mpea_production_store.py',
           HERE/'tests/test_mpea_fixture_driver.py',
           ROOT/'scripts/mpea_study_supervisor.py',Path(__file__).resolve(),
           HERE/'contract-conformance-integration-v1.md',
           ROOT/'docs/mpea-t25-archival-protocol-v1.md',
           ROOT/'docs/mpea-t25-implementation-contract-v1.md']
    names += [Path(sys.modules[name].__file__).resolve() for name in driver.implementation_snapshot()]
    names=sorted(set(p.resolve() for p in names))
    def capture():return {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in names}
    before=capture();command=[sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(HERE/'tests'),'-p','test_mpea_archive*.py','-v']
    report=HERE/'reports';report.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    label='contract-author-v2';log=report/(label+'.log');receipt=report/(label+'.json')
    if log.exists() or receipt.exists():raise RuntimeError('OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS')
    started=time.monotonic();env=dict(os.environ);env.pop('PYTHONPATH',None)
    with log.open('xb') as output:
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1200)
    after=capture();raw=log.read_bytes();summary=re.search(rb'Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s\s+OK\s*\Z',raw)
    value={'schema':'lupine.mpea.constructed-conformance-author.v1','command':command,
        'exit_code':result.returncode,'test_count':None if summary is None else int(summary.group(1)),
        'passed':result.returncode==0 and summary is not None and before==after,
        'source_before':before,'source_after':after,'sources_unchanged':before==after,
        'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'log':{'path':str(log.relative_to(ROOT)),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest()},
        'actual_source_read':False,'actual_feature_read':False,'actual_allocation':False,
        'scope':'constructed fixtures; exact scientific flow plus actual resource/namespace supervisor; no production registration'}
    data=(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
    with receipt.open('xb') as output:output.write(data)
    print(json.dumps({key:value[key] for key in ('passed','test_count','exit_code','sources_unchanged','elapsed_seconds')},sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if value['passed'] else 1
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
